buildCommand: curl -L https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.24.5-stable.tar.xz -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && tar -xf /tmp/flutter.tar.xz -C /tmp && export PATH=/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH && flutter config --enable-web && flutter precache --web && flutter build web --release
